name: catalog-completeness-check
description: Every morning, finds products that are missing images, prices, weights, categories or translations and posts a short to-do list to Slack, newest problems first.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every day at a time you choose

howItWorks.label: Checks
howItWorks.text: Every active product for missing images, price, weight, category, description and translations

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A to-do list to Slack, grouped by what is missing, with what is new since yesterday

howItWorks.label: Never
howItWorks.text: Changes a product; it only reports

plugins.reason: Posts the daily to-do list to your team's channel

data.description: The product's name, to identify it in the list
The SKU, so the team finds the product quickly
Whether the product is live, draft or archived, so archived products are ignored
The product's images or main image
The long description shown on the product page
Translated fields or translation records, when the store sells in several languages

parameters.label: Slack channel
parameters.description: Where the to-do list is posted

parameters.label: What counts as complete
parameters.default: at least one image, a price above 0, a weight, a category, a description of at least 30 words, every translation
parameters.description: The checks to run, in plain words; leave out the ones your store does not need

parameters.label: Check draft products too
parameters.description: When off, only live products are checked

parameters.label: Products to list
parameters.description: The list shows at most this many products; the rest are counted
